title: Best ice cream scoop I've had by far!
text: Best ice cream scoop I've had by far!. I had actually bought one like these ones before because both my husband and I don't like the normal ones and it didn't work for us and I had pretty much given up and decided to give it a second try but actually reading the reviews and checking to see which was my best option and I came upon this one, I bought it without truly knowing if it was as good as it said and knowing I had owned a different brand exactly like this one that didn't work but surprisingly this one was awesome! It works just great, the problem I had with the one I bought before was it got stuck a lot for some reason and again for some reason it just didn't work when it came to serving but this one is the total opposite amazing, easy to use, easy to serve and easy to clean obviously, I am definitely in love with this !

product_metadata.title: BALCI Ice Cream Scoop - Heavy Duty Stainless Steel Icecream Scooper With Non-Slip Rubber Grip - Professional Metal Ice-Cream Spade - Dishwasher Safe – Mint
features: Smart Pointed Tip: Life's Too Short for Melted Ice Cream. Now you can smoothly glide through rock-solid frozen ice-cream cartons with the Balci premium ice cream scoop, thanks to its chisel tip!

Solid Stainless Steel: Not All Scoops Are Created Equal! Unlike all those flimsy ice cream scoopers that bend easily, our heavy-duty, professional ice cream scoop is made from indestructible stainless steel!

Ergonomic Rubber Grip: All The Ice-Cream, Minus The Mess! Our nonstick ice cream scoop features a comfy and non-slip B.P.A. Free rubber handle, which is ideal for children, adults and seniors who can't wait to have ice-cream!
Dishwasher-Safe Scooper: Less Time Washing, More Time Scooping! Done with your delicious ice-cream Sundae? Just slip your ergonomic metal icecream scoop in your dishwasher and you're good to go!
Quality Without Compromise - We stand behind our commitment of offering the highest of quality design and materials to make exceptional products.
